Manchester City faces Premier League charges over financial rules

Manchester City has been charged by the Premier League with over 100 breaches of financial rules. The alleged violations span from the 2009-10 season to the 2017-18 campaign. The charges relate to financial fair play regulations and the provision of accurate financial information. The Premier League stated that the club has been referred to an independent commission. The outcome of this process remains undetermined.
